channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Backyard feeders may spread bird flu as outbreak grows
item.description: As Australia's bird flu outbreak expands, backyard feeders could become unexpected transmission points, bringing birds together in ways that rarely occur naturally.

item.title: Extreme sleep durations may accelerate biological aging
item.description: Both insufficient and excessive sleep may speed up aging across the body. Analysis of 23 biological clocks found the slowest aging occurred with moderate sleep.

item.title: Faint stellar ribbon around distant galaxy reveals dark matter
item.description: A faint ribbon of stars around a distant galaxy marks the first globular cluster stream found beyond the Milky Way. Its shape hints at dark matter's presence.

item.title: Medications may leave lasting changes to gut microbiome
item.description: Common medications may reshape the gut microbiome long after the last dose. A study of over 2,500 people found lasting microbial changes.
